sanskrit_verse:
तेजोमात्रं समुद्धृत्य राज्ञो मूर्तिर् हि निर्मिता ।
तस्य सवाणि भूतानि चराणि स्थावराणि च ॥१,१.७॥
transliteration: tejomātraṃ samuddhṛtya rājño mūrtir hi nirmitā / tasya savāṇi bhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca // BrhS_1,1.7 //
sph_interpretive_translation: From the pure essence of Tejas, the sovereign form of the King was manifested; all beings—mobile and immobile—are sustained by him.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the sovereign embodiment of divine consciousness.
Causation flows from the radiant source of governance to all manifest entities.
Capacity-based responsibility is inherent in those who embody sovereignty.
Restoration logic aligns with the natural sustenance of all life forms.
Consciousness alignment occurs through recognition of the sovereign's sustaining role.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a being holds sovereign consciousness THEN it sustains all mobile and immobile entities.
IF an entity manifests tejomātra THEN it possesses the capacity for lawful sovereignty.
IF a ruler is constituted from pure Tejas THEN all subjects are inherently preserved under its authority.
IF misalignment arises THEN restoration must occur via reconnection to the sovereign Tejas-source.
IF dharma is obscured THEN realign through acknowledgment of the King’s sustaining function.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, only one who has fully embodied the tejomātra may assume the seat of final judgment. The court's function is not punitive but to restore alignment between the sovereign and the governed, ensuring that all actions reflect the preservation of both mobile and immobile beings within the cosmic order.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here establishes pramāṇa through direct perception of the sovereign's Tejas as the sustaining force. Misalignment follows anupūrvaśaḥ — sequential deviation from the source. Responsibility lies in restoring connection, not inflicting consequence. The measure of response is proportional to the degree of disconnection, never exceeding restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Savana Yajña to reconnect the subject with the sovereign Tejas.
Assign completion process wherein the individual assumes responsibility for reintegration.
Deploy Vak-siddhi practices to restore truthful alignment with the King's sustaining will.
Establish Tapas-based capacity rebuilding for those whose consciousness has dimmed.
Perform Rajasuya rectification to reaffirm the sovereign's sustaining presence in societal order.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is executed. Sovereignty arises from Tejas, sustains all existence, and restores through consciousness alone. There is no punishment, only alignment. Reality itself is the judge, and consciousness is the ultimate enforcer.
